description: This script verifies that flags in Go source files do not contain underscores, by scanning files and comparing against an excluded flags list.

methods.name: is_binary
methods.description: Detects if a file is binary by reading chunks and checking for null bytes.

methods.name: get_all_files
methods.description: Recursively collects all non-binary files in a directory, excluding certain directories.

methods.name: check_underscore_in_flags
methods.description: Checks Go files for flags with underscores not listed in excluded flags.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets root directory, gathers files, and runs the check.
